answer: Require each agent identity to post a ferrous bond, a refundable stake locked for a full epoch, before it may attest or trade. Trust grows only through a trellis of cross-attestations: established agents vouch for newcomers, and a voucher's own stake is slashed if its vouchee proves fake. An attacker must fund a separate bond per fake identity and bribe real vouchers, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand bonds plus forfeited voucher stakes. Like an ember without fuel, a Sybil ring starves once its bonds are slashed faster than it can replenish them.
